selection_rule: Take the highest-priority queued item that closes a material Lead-assessment gap. Extend existing contracts before creating a new model. Prefer practice that improves explanation, diagnosis, design, and challenge skills over adding another broad topic list.
done_definition: human page is useful without machine data
important ownership and integration boundaries are represented
failure modes and diagnostic questions are included
at least one assessment case points to the material
content remains draft/noindex until human review

items.title: Adaptive practice engine and weak-signal profile
Focused review queue
items.working_rule: Review one weak signal, then repeat a related case.

items.title: Balanced mock assessment session
items.working_rule: Cover all four tracks, higher reasoning levels, and cross-process cases before using weak-signal weighting.

items.title: Progress and portable local history
items.working_rule: Attempts are the durable record. Profiles and recommendations are derived from attempts after import.

items.title: Feedback and calibration evidence
items.working_rule: Keep provenance explicit. Feedback can suggest a calibration change but cannot silently modify the scoring model.

items.title: Graph-backed question candidate review
items.working_rule: Generate only from whitelisted graph evidence. Reject duplicates before review. Human review still does not publish a case automatically.

items.title: Assessment-linked Lab promotion readiness audit
items.working_rule: Structural readiness does not imply verified or public. Factual, source, release-sensitivity, and index-policy review remain explicit human decisions.

items.title: Claim-level factual and primary-source review
items.working_rule: Source-supported claims remain separate from page-level human verification and publication policy.

items.title: Factual review batch two: ATP, Credit, EWM, Deployment
items.working_rule: Review load-bearing product behavior and deployment boundaries against primary SAP sources, then keep page verification separate.

items.title: Evidence-aware promotion prioritization
items.working_rule: Prioritize mature enterprise pages with missing, conflicting, or release-unclear evidence before routes that already have source-supported claims. Never promote automatically.

items.title: Factual review batch three: core logistics execution and finance
items.working_rule: Review only load-bearing claims that change process ownership, diagnosis, execution, or financial completion. Keep source support separate from page verification.

items.title: Assessment-track evidence coverage matrix
items.working_rule: Select the next factual-review batch from cross-track P0 evidence debt, not from page count or editing convenience.

items.title: Evidence classes and route evidence profiles
items.working_rule: Validate product facts with product primary sources, standards with their owning specifications, research claims with original research, and keep author heuristics explicitly non-factual.

items.title: AI/Data and Integration product-primary factual review
items.working_rule: Improve assessment balance by reviewing load-bearing SAP product facts in AI/Data and Integration, while keeping generic architecture heuristics in their own evidence class.

items.title: Core Sales, Procurement, Shipping, and MDG interface factual review
items.working_rule: Close high-value P0 evidence debt on determination and replication decisions before adding more breadth.

items.title: Close broad required evidence debt
items.working_rule: Complete source review where product evidence is a required gate, and explicitly classify authored diagnostic reasoning instead of forcing it into a product-fact model.

items.title: Evidence-gated assessment candidate generation
items.working_rule: Fail candidate generation before question construction when the route evidence profile, factual-review state, or source verification is incomplete. Evidence eligibility never publishes a case automatically.

items.title: Source-supported human page-review queue
items.working_rule: Use source-supported Promotion Readiness routes to order page-level human review. Never change verified, status, robots, sitemap, or publication state automatically.

items.title: Evidence-gated Production candidate expansion
items.working_rule: Expand question generation only where a source-supported graph adds a new diagnostic signal. Duplicate rejection and human promotion remain mandatory.

items.title: Sales Order Lead-answer editorial and consistency pass
items.working_rule: Improve assessment usefulness and evidence transparency without changing page verification or publication state. Keep runtime diagnosis before configuration changes.

items.title: Pricing and Procurement Lead-answer consistency pass
items.working_rule: Expose domain-specific Lead answer frames and factual-review boundaries without replacing the deeper graph model or changing verification/publication state.

items.title: ATP and Shipping Lead-boundary consistency pass
items.working_rule: Separate promise ownership from shipping/scheduling ownership, expose first-wrong-decision diagnostics, and keep factual review distinct from page verification.

items.title: Execution and completion boundary pass
items.working_rule: Separate local technical completion from stock, warehouse, business, and financial completion. Keep completion models explicitly authored and factual claims source-bound.

items.title: Close the twelve-route core human-review wave
items.working_rule: Close the first core assessment content wave with domain-specific ownership/completion models and explicit evidence boundaries. Do not mark any page verified or public automatically.

items.title: Core 12 assessment study map
items.working_rule: Study the core routes as ownership and diagnostic chains. Enrich the qualitative contract from factual-review and published-case data without changing verification or publication state.

items.title: Core 12 cross-route ownership drills
items.working_rule: Practice the first ownership change between evidence-supported Core 12 routes. Keep drills synthetic, review-safe, and outside the published assessment case manifest.

items.title: Timed Core 12 Board Mode
items.working_rule: Use the existing Core boundary drills and shared scoring contract for timed oral practice. Do not create a second history format or publish practice data automatically.

items.title: Production candidate semantic review
items.working_rule: Use semantic review after deterministic dedup. Retain only candidates that add a materially new Lead reasoning signal, and never publish them without a separate human promotion decision.

items.title: Board Mode targeted review handoff
items.working_rule: Aggregate Board self-scores only in the current browser-memory session, then route the two weakest dimensions to the existing Review Map. Do not write history, recalibrate scoring, or create a second profile model.

items.title: Human page-review finding contract
items.working_rule: Record true reviewer evidence through all seven page-review gates. Never infer human verification from automation, and never alter verified, indexing, status, or publication state from the finding recorder.

items.title: Secondary human-review priority map
items.working_rule: After the Core 12 wave, rank source-supported secondary pages by direct published-case reuse and cross-track assessment value. Priority orders review work only and never changes verification or publication state.

items.title: High-reuse secondary editorial consistency pass
items.working_rule: Use the secondary review ranking to inspect high-reuse pages, but edit only real assessment gaps. Add domain-specific answer frames and evidence boundaries without changing verification or publication state.

items.title: Published-case reasoning pressure coverage
items.working_rule: Use exact case track and reasoning-level metadata to identify thin Diagnose, Design, and Challenge cells. Treat the two-case threshold as an explicit authoring heuristic, not a scoring or factual claim.

items.title: AI/Data Diagnose evidence-backed candidate expansion
items.working_rule: Fill the thin AI/Data Diagnose cell only after adding claim-level SAP primary evidence for the exact Agent Architecture route. Keep Sales Design and AI/Data Challenge outside the diagnose-only generation pattern.

items.title: AI/Data Diagnose candidate semantic review
items.working_rule: Reject evidence-backed candidates that repeat an existing Lead reasoning signal. Retain RAW-MCP for human promotion review and reject over-privileged-agent diagnosis as a semantic duplicate of ASSESS-AI-003.

items.title: Non-diagnostic reasoning-gap authoring contract
items.working_rule: Do not force Design and Challenge gaps through a symptom-to-root-cause generator. Require explicit alternatives, ownership, trade-offs, decision-changing conditions, and source-supported evidence routes while keeping all candidates outside the published manifest.
